## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, the DCO; see CONTRIBUTING)
- [ ] `make test SUITES=c,fast` passes locally
- [ ] New code is covered by tests (see CONTRIBUTING)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md is updated under [Unreleased] for user-visible changes
- [ ] Substantial changes were discussed in an issue beforehand
